scope: future independent implementation acceptance; NOT executed by design checker

acceptance.clause: Simulated cut at every erase/program stage retains old or new valid configuration
Writes are serialized and wear budget documented
Protocol save acceptance distinguished from durable completion
Capability is consumed from its declared repository by an independent downstream fixture with no drone-specific dependency

initial_conditions: A valid seq7 B valid seq6
B valid seq7 A valid seq6

oracle.owner: independent reviewer/fixture, distinct from product decoder
oracle.valid_set: {old complete snapshot,new captured snapshot}, or {validated defaults,new} for blank media
oracle.comparison: entire schema/length/canonical bytes, record sequence and explicit status; never CRC alone
exclusions: unqualified/violated R1 monotone-transition, stable read, ECC visibility or isolation contract; separate physical qualification, never a CRC-collision exception for permitted cuts
independent arbitrary nonmonotone valid-codeword replacement; information-theoretic residual risk, not a modeled interruption success
oracle.preconditions: Healthy selected old or validated defaults; every erase Q-qualified before permit. All modeled subsets, including original F1 transition, remain in scope. Unsupported/ambiguity/Q-unsafe prestates reject writes explicitly.
oracle.proof: specs/erase-integrity-proof.md; arbitrary-subset theorem distinct from finite test counts

cases.title: All destructive byte prefixes
cases.workload: 5 geometries x 3 initial configurations x every erase byte prefix 0..E and every body/marker granule byte prefix 0..G; reboot at each prefix
cases.oracle: Independent raw-media decoder selects old/new only; blank start defaults/new. Check whole canonical payload, unchanged active RAM and untouched current slot.

cases.title: Non-prefix bits, directed codeword transformations and ECC
cases.workload: Retain exact raw-v1 F1 programs/images/mask and expected exit1. Apply witness mask to corrected data rails; independently generate complete accepted bodies differing in sequence/version/schema/duplicate-sequence/source labels/CRC. Search both erase and program partial orders, enumerate all two-bit pair states/transitions and all 256 partial-byte program masks at every G1 command. Each larger G: every single transition, alternating masks,4096 seeded subsets (17,1701) per geometry.
cases.oracle: All R1 cuts recover old/new; no distinct complementary accepted body is erase-reachable. Check stored CRC is encoded too and complement validation precedes unsupported/sequence selection. Pair algebra supplies all-subsets proof; samples are not physical proof. ECC explicit read-only/fallback/default.

cases.title: Single-bit and structured corruption
cases.workload: Flip every bit in each E1024 slot for G8,16384 single-bit images. Independently invalid target with pair00, pair11, nonzero marker, bad logical padding/CRC/reserved and damaged physical alignment/tail; include a high-sequence record repaired by erase if Q is bypassed.
cases.oracle: Malformed record never decoded as Valid. Q1/Q2/Q3-safe invalid prestates cannot gain authority during any erase; Q-unsafe00/damaged-tail negative controls deny erase before permit and preserve old RAM/media. Arbitrary nonmonotone accepted-codeword replacement explicitly outside theorem; no CRC exception for modeled cuts.

cases.title: Version and semantic recovery
cases.workload: Formats0/1/2/3/65535; schema0/1/2/65535, older/equal/newer seq and both slot orders. Generate fully complementary unknown envelopes with valid CRC to test genuine Unsupported dominance; directed searches toward unknown versions/schemas from each valid predecessor, and bit changes to magic/length/reserved/CRC/padding. Raw-v1 record must not be a compatibility alias.
cases.oracle: R3 classification: pair validity BEFORE common-envelope/CRC BEFORE unknown lookup BEFORE selection. No erased predecessor can become a new Unsupported record; genuine intact unknown locks writes. Explicit invalid defaults/error behavior. Q still mandatory on corrupt media.

cases.title: Sequence edges and duplicate records
cases.workload: Sequences0/1/2/6/7/8/14/MAX-1/MAX; both slot orders; exact duplicates and equal-sequence different payload/source labels. Directed complete-codeword comparisons attempt predecessor->greater sequence and predecessor->selected sequence with different bytes, with freshly correct stored CRC. Four exhaustion saves plus exact DurableExisting.
cases.oracle: No different accepted codeword reachable by erase/program partial order. Numeric ordering; seq0 invalid; genuine equal-different ambiguous/read-only; identical duplicate deterministic A; no wrap and no erase at MAX for changed save. Same snapshot needs no wear.

cases.title: Reset and retry at every state
cases.workload: 10 active/reconciliation boundaries x Reset/Stop/reconnect/power-cycle x 3 repeat arrivals =120 traces; old completion after every io_epoch change
cases.oracle: Resources never reacquired; admitted operation reconciled, no duplicate erase/program, result/fence retained until release; reboot scans authoritative.

cases.title: Snapshot versus later RAM edit
cases.workload: 1000 runs alternating LED values; capture revision R, edit R+1 before each of six storage phases; T07 u32 revision wrap fixture from reviewed API tests
cases.oracle: Durable bytes always captured R, active remains later bytes; CRC, sequence and readback match immutable capture, revision wrap not treated as identity.

cases.title: One and four clients
cases.workload: 1 then 4 clients; 10000 interleaved requests, duplicates, busy, result saturation, disconnects; deterministic seeds 7 and17
cases.oracle: One global flash operation, four bounded client results, no lost/evicted outcome; exact release-before-next ordering and stale/retired fence.

cases.title: Deadline, cancellation and Ready
cases.workload: Arrival at deadline-1,deadline,deadline+1; delay validation clock; ResolveOrCancel before/after admission; 32 lifecycle/key combinations
cases.oracle: Fresh deadline sample at C; cancelled tombstone blocks later save; pending cannot be cancelled; no admission before Ready or during quiesce.

cases.title: Finite wear across reboot
cases.workload: W_A=W_B=100; 200 successful alternating saves, 201st rejected; repeat with every 3rd erase interrupted and reboot; 100 duplicate permit completions; resumed attempts require backend authorization and Q; unavailable or Q-unsafe media must not reset/extend allowance; fixed200 receipt entries outside simulated MCU reset domain.
cases.oracle: Total physical erase admissions <=200 including uncertain attempts. No token refresh/reissue; unavailable authority rejects. One-second synthetic rate gate.

cases.title: Backend failure and quarantine
cases.workload: Inject error/timeout/read ECC at every command index for all 5 geometries; marker issued/completed but completion lost; quiesce failure; 3 retries per terminal
cases.oracle: Before marker definite NoNewCommit only with stopped engine; after marker exact reread or Indeterminate. No blind retry or quarantine clearing on Reset.

cases.title: Allocation and cleanup
cases.workload: Guard all four allocator entry points after freeze; 10000 operations one/four clients including C06/C08/C11, first poll, timers, Stop/Reset/fault and task cleanup
cases.oracle: Zero attempted heap calls; deliberate forbidden-call controls prove guard. Actual runtime separately required; tests own allocations excluded explicitly.

cases.title: Command correlation and saturation
cases.workload: Capacity-one command/completion slots; duplicate/out-of-order/wrong-slot/wrong-epoch completions at each of 99 commands (including wear acquisition) for G8/E1024; 1000 pump schedules
cases.oracle: Owned outstanding command retained and reconciled, no concurrent operation or lost wake; retained completion never overwritten.

cases.title: Independent layout/checksum vectors
cases.workload: All 9 supported G, payload lengths1/4/8/255/256; manually derived LED vector and CRC32C check123456789; invalid geometry G0/3/512,E0/511/65537,misalignment/overlap; E512 rejected for every G; all legal E values satisfy M+G<=E; CRC domain logical0..60+64..320 independent of G; full complementary byte-pair vectors.
cases.oracle: Independent encoder/decoder agrees bytes/CRC/marker offset; malformed geometry rejected before backend use.

cases.title: Validation and boot installation
cases.workload: LED bounds 99/100/10000/10001 and duty0/500/1000/1001; thermostat scalar/cross-field bounds; invalid defaults
cases.oracle: Only validated complete values installed once before Ready; boot active revision0 and saved source revision separate. Failed save never changes RAM.

cases.title: Torn/restored marker and repeated interruptions
cases.workload: G1 exhaust256 marker masks; G8 marker prefixes0..8; paired destructive command boundaries at G8/E1024:83^2 pairs (before erase + after erase + after each of 80 body commands + after commit). Reerase interrupted erase/body/commit prestates after explicit backend authorization AND Q. Check marker unchangedzero/partiallyerased/allFF, prohibition on restoring zero by erase, and full erase then later reprogram same zero marker with different capture.
cases.oracle: Inductive Q invariant and old/new after each admitted cut; same marker bytes do not confer authority on mixed/old body. Full FF verification separates erase from new programming. Q-unsafe independently invalid state rejects before erase; quiescence/quarantine/wear still independent requirements.

cases.title: Same durable snapshot and rate budget
cases.workload: 1000 same snapshot requests, then equal bytes/new revision, then same revision/different bytes and epoch; saturated slot and MAX seq
cases.oracle: Exact identity+bytes yields zero flash/wear; changed capture requires record, Busy never evicts; readback remains truthful.

cases.title: Bounded storage and resource ownership
cases.workload: Maximum E65536 G256 payload256, four clients,32 trace slots; sizeof/static/linker report and constructor/drop instrumentation; two1024-byte physical images +320 decoded logical scratch; stream Q flags without E-sized RAM.
cases.oracle: Core+adapter+slots <=8192 bytes; streaming scans, no double initialization/move, no heap cleanup/reacquisition.

cases.title: Independent unrelated consumer
cases.workload: Thermostat schema2, immutable Git dependency in external workspace;100 alternating saves/reboots plus every G8/E1024 erase/program prefix
cases.oracle: Real library consumed; independent oracle sees old/new valid thermostat, no drone/platform dependency or copied codec.

cases.title: Pinned adapter and targets
cases.workload: Git pin T07 exact accepted rev; --locked host tests and no_std thumb check; dependency tree and source/manifest hashes
cases.oracle: No mutable neighbor paths, fabricated lock or runtime in messages; library reuse proof separate from hardware and T36.

cases.title: P wire accepted/pending/durable
cases.workload: Actual endpoint plus pinned unchanged pyXCP;100 saves with held backend completion, GET_STATUS polls and all320 readback bytes; RAM edit after capture
cases.oracle: FF means admitted only, bit0 pending then fulfilled, stable readback matches capture; raw and decoded assertions. Deferred P-OPEN-1/2.

cases.title: P failures and S0 immutability
cases.workload: S0 F9 negative; P short/long/mode/id invalid, busy, lost FF, late flash error, reconnect/reboot;10 repeats each
cases.oracle: Exact reviewed error/status vectors, no repeat F9 after unknown result, no PGM; P late-failure expectations deferred until primary evidence review.

cases.title: P metadata and readback
cases.workload: Pinned pya2ldb parse; mismatched schema/build/profile refuses writes; four320-byte latches;7-byte upload chunks; all blob write addresses
cases.oracle: No private save register; coherent immutable view and readonly rejection; raw upstream sources unmodified. P activation deferred.
